name: traversy-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods from Brad Traversy

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: Shows the current Git branch, context, and account usage above the prompt with detailed session information

plugins.name: impact-map
plugins.description: Tracks touched files and opens current Git diffs for changed files

plugins.name: tool-cards
plugins.description: Replaces tool-use rows with compact status cards

plugins.name: verification-ledger
plugins.description: Tracks local verification commands and GitHub Actions for the current commit

plugins.name: agent-pulse
plugins.description: Shows live subagent activity and recent transcripts in a session pane

plugins.name: work-queue
plugins.description: Shows Claude session tasks grouped by working, blocked, ready, and done
